prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer. Make ONE materially revised compact pixel-art dialogue portrait on actual transparent background.
INPUTS: image 1 is Fuduo v1, the edit target whose identity was checked against her approved mother. Images 2-5 are exact Mara/Iwo/Leiya/Tore low-resolution STYLE references only. Redraw v1 to match their head scale and block economy.
CORRECT THE CURRENT FAILURES DECISIVELY:
1. REPLACE BOTH BIG BRIGHT EYES with small, narrow horizontal dark eye clusters. Each eye no more than a few logical pixels wide and one or two pixels high. No white oval, no cream triangular white patch, no glossy or anime eye. At most a tiny dull warm gray sliver embedded in the shadow. Flatten the excessively raised worried eyebrow peaks; retain a steady determined sideways viewer-right glance and a little private worry. She is an energetic self-directed adult farmer in her twenties.
2. GREATLY SHORTEN THE NECK AND REMOVE THE CHEST. Raise the thin clothing collar to almost meet the jaw: only 3-5 logical pixels of neck should show in the 100-pixel design. Fill the recovered space by making the face, jaw and bold cheek/nose planes LARGER. Broad head, sturdy adult jaw, short neck, bottommost narrow ochre collar and just a hint of sage apron straps. Do not make a small-face bust.
3. REDUCE DETAIL INTO LARGE HARD COLOR BLOCKS. Model hair in 3-4 broad dark-brown locks, not layered thin parallel ribbons. Nose/cheek/forehead planes must be clear chunky stepped pixels. No subtle skin gradient or freckle noise. Design directly for a 74x100 logical grid, large unambiguous clusters and <=32 earthy colors, comparable to the four STYLE images. This is not a smooth illustrated cartoon.
IDENTITY INVARIANTS: Fuduo Gu / OSB-NPC-FUD, twenty-something adult woman with wheat-tanned skin, central-parted deep brown hair, ONE thick braid on viewer-right, wide-set small eyes, SHORT slightly upturned nose, distinctive thick lower lip and compact angular jaw. Preserve the simple self-dyed faded sage-gray headscarf behind the exposed central part, its practical cloth tie and front locks; keep ochre work-dress collar and sage-gray apron hints. Firm mouth without glamorous shine. Single side braid should have only a few broad lobes and be fully completed in a short rounded end beside the jaw/collar, at least 3 logical pixels above the bottom edge. No change to child, older woman or another character.
FRAMING: complete head/scarf crown and all visible ears/hair edges, with 3 logical pixels of genuine outer margin on every side. Full braid end visible; no source crop hidden by padding. Near-frontal slight viewer-right turn. Face fills most available area, tiny neck, narrow bottom collar; avoid added shoulder width. No text, frame, props, hands, body, background, tool or scene. Upper-left light, actual transparency, hard pixel-cluster silhouettes. Preserve latest headscarf while dramatically improving dark small eyes and face-to-neck ratio.
